The Élan Experience.

Two days built for momentum. This is the shape of Élan, the flow of it rather than the stopwatch. Exact timings live inside your participant portal.

Register NowExplore Crisis CommandExplore Cent$ible
Day 1 · 5 September

Opening to cultural night.

  • Arrival, registration and breakfast
  • Grand Opening Ceremony
  • Flagship preliminary rounds: Crisis Command and Cent$ible run at the same time in separate venues
  • Day 1 submissions, questioning and finalist announcement
  • Open Stage
  • Cultural Night
Day 2 · 6 September

Grand finals to closing ceremony.

  • Finalist check-in
  • Grand finals in parallel: the Crisis Command Final and the Cent$ible Final Boardroom, both concluding before lunch
  • Judges’ deliberation
  • Élan Carnival
  • Grand Closing and Awards Ceremony
